Research Engineer, Engineering Hub at Renaissance Philanthropy

This position is fully remote, with some travel (<10%).  Base salary for this role is $125k-$180K, and up to $200k for more senior roles, plus a discretionary bonus.

About Renaissance Philanthropy

Renaissance Philanthropy is a nonprofit with a mission to fuel a 21st-century renaissance by increasing the ambition of philanthropists, scientists and innovators.

About the Engineering Hub

The Renaissance Philanthropy Engineering Hub provides on-demand development technical assistance in support of grant-funded educational technology projects.
